start: Phone app updated; the watch app is an older version

steps.action: Open MettleUp on the watch (or just wear it: the version is written on start, boot and update)
user_sees: Nothing new on the watch
must_not: A pop-up on the watch

steps.action: Open MettleUp on the phone
user_sees: The phone says a watch update is ready (the phone's exact words were not read here)
must_not: No word on the phone while the watch is older
'Update ready' when both are the same version

start: Watch app installed but never opened

steps.action: Open MettleUp on the phone
user_sees: The phone asks the watch for its version and then says whether an update is ready
must_not: 'Update ready' for a watch that is already up to date
A crash on the phone

start: Phone says a watch update is ready

steps.action: Update the watch app from the Play Store on the watch
user_sees: The phone's message goes away
must_not: The message staying after the watch is updated

steps.action: App starts
user_sees: (No screen) the watch writes its version name and number to the shared item and announces it is installed
must_not: The write repeated and synced again when nothing changed
A crash when Google Play services is missing

start: Watch reboots, or the watch app is updated, or the phone asks

steps.action: Boot, update or the phone's ask arrives
user_sees: (No screen) the item is written again, the update case with the new version
must_not: The old version left in the item after an update

start: The write fails (Play services busy) or the package has no version

steps.action: App starts
user_sees: (No screen) a warning in the log; the next start tries again
must_not: A crash
A version of 0 or empty written to the item

start: The item was already written in this process

steps.action: The listener wakes again
user_sees: (No screen) no second write
must_not: A new sync on every wake

steps.action: The phone asks again
user_sees: (No screen) written again on purpose
must_not: The phone's ask ignored

steps.action: The item is shared with the paired phone
user_sees: (No screen) only the app's version name and number
must_not: The member's name, workouts or heart rate in the item
The item sent anywhere but the member's own phone

user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Do step 2 of "Watch update ready" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 1 of "Watch update ready", carry on, then turn it back on.
user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost saved data, a double saved data after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: Watch out of range: the phone must keep the last version it got
